name: industrial-monitoring-center
description: IMC single-workshop industrial monitoring digital twin

scripts.dev:live: concurrently -k -n realtime,simulator,web -c cyan,magenta,green "npm run dev:realtime" "npm run dev:simulator" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.dev:live:db: concurrently -k -n api,realtime,simulator,web -c yellow,cyan,magenta,green "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:realtime" "npm run dev:simulator" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.dev:live:spike: concurrently -k -n realtime,simulator,web -c cyan,magenta,green "npm run dev:realtime" "npm run dev:simulator:spike" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.dev:live:hot: concurrently -k -n realtime,simulator,web -c cyan,magenta,green "npm run dev:realtime" "npm run dev:simulator:hot" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.dev:live:power: concurrently -k -n realtime,simulator,web -c cyan,magenta,green "npm run dev:realtime" "npm run dev:simulator:power" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @imc/shared-types && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.docker:down: docker compose -f deploy/docker-compose.yml --env-file .env --profile mvp --profile infra --profile full --profile timeseries down
